notes: RNA-seq arm of a ribosome-profiling protocol (linker ligation with RNA ligase, circularization), so assay_class other. RRF knock-down by shifting from LB+arabinose to LB+glucose; wild type got the same medium changes, so no treatment axis: treatment none for all (medium changes treated as part of the depletion protocol, not a medium shift; could alternatively be medium_or_oxygen_shift). Phase mid_exponential inferred from OD 0.2 in LB before the 15-70 min after the first change. Gene for RRF given only as 'RRF'.
